## How it was solved
solved: B8 lattice CVP recovers 48-bit LCG state from 8 top-bytes; key[0:8]=forward w1 (pt[8:16]), key[8:16]=backward k9 (IV[0:8]); a odd=>invertible. 50/50 local, live OK.
